blocks.en: Every ship in EVE has a Directional Scanner (d-scan) that can be used to discover the rough location of certain kinds of objects up to 14 AU (appx. 2 x109 km) away from the ship. There are other kinds of specialized scanners, such as the probe launcher (used in Exploration) or the survey scanner (used in Mining), but the d-scan comes with the ship and requires no additional training or fitting costs.
blocks.zh: EVE 中的每艘舰船都有定向扫描（D-Scan），可以发现距离舰船 14 AU（约 2 x109 km）以内某些物体的大致方位。此外还有其它专用扫描设备，比如探针发射器（用于探索）或测量扫描器（用于采矿），但定向扫描是舰船自带的，不需要额外的技能训练，也不占装配资源。

blocks.en: What d-scan is good for
blocks.zh: 定向扫描能做什么

blocks.en: The directional scanner can see the following objects in space:
blocks.zh: 定向扫描可以看到太空中的以下物体：

en: All ships and their names. This excludes combat recon and cloaked ships.
Celestial objects such as moons, asteroid belts and planets.
Structures such as player starbases, citadels, customs offices, mobile depots and stargates. The name of the structure is also visible.
Wrecks
Drones
Core and combat scanning probes

NPCs with "♦" in their name. This includes mining operations, Blood Raider shipyard fleets and NPC ships in the AEGIS Capital Ship Security Facility, AEGIS Secure Transfer Facility and SCC Secure Key Storage.
zh: 所有舰船及其名称。但战斗侦察舰和隐形中的舰船除外。
天体，如卫星、小行星带和行星。
建筑，如玩家母星（POS）、堡垒、海关办公室、移动式仓库和星门。建筑的名称也能看到。
残骸
无人机
核心扫描探针和作战扫描探针
名称中带“♦”的 NPC。包括采矿作业、血袭者船坞舰队，以及AEGIS 旗舰安保设施、AEGIS 安全转运设施和SCC 安全密钥储存库中的 NPC 舰船。

blocks.en: The directional scanner is not able to see the state of the object (empty, damaged, reinforced, pilot info), nor can it see cosmic signatures, cosmic anomalies, normal NPCs, beacons or bookmarks.
blocks.zh: 定向扫描无法看到物体的状态（空的、受损、增强中、飞行员信息），也看不到宇宙信号、宇宙异常、普通 NPC、信标或书签。

blocks.en: The directional scanner can be used to see most ships or probes that may pose a threat, or to gather intel on objects that are off grid such as enemy fleets. This is especially important in wormholes as the local chat there does not automatically show other players, and the d-scan is a good tool for this situation.
blocks.zh: 定向扫描可以用来发现大多数可能构成威胁的舰船或探针，或者收集不在同一网格的目标情报，比如敌方舰队。这在虫洞中尤其重要，因为那里的本地频道不会自动显示其他玩家，而定向扫描正是应对这种情况的好工具。

blocks.en: How to use it
blocks.zh: 如何使用

blocks.en: To open the directional scanner press Alt + D.
blocks.zh: 按 Alt + D 打开定向扫描。

en: Alternatively, click the "radar" button (just above the autopilot button) on the left-hand side of the HUD, and when the window with the four items opens, choose the directional scanner.
zh: 也可以点击 HUD 左侧的“雷达”按钮（就在自动驾驶按钮上方），在弹出的四个选项窗口中选择定向扫描。

blocks.en: Either of these will bring up the d-scan window and system map as shown next.
blocks.zh: 以上任一方式都会打开定向扫描窗口和星系地图，如下图所示。

blocks.en: D-scan window docked inside the system map
blocks.zh: 嵌在星系地图中的定向扫描窗口

blocks.en: By default the d-scan window is docked inside the system map. You can undock it if you wish, in which case you will later need to open the d-scan and the map separately.
blocks.zh: 默认情况下，定向扫描窗口嵌在星系地图中。你也可以把它分离出来，这样之后就需要分别打开定向扫描和地图。

blocks.en: D-scan window undock/dock switch
blocks.zh: 定向扫描窗口的分离 / 嵌入开关

blocks.en: The map and the cone
blocks.zh: 地图与扫描锥

blocks.en: The d-scan search begins at your ship and extends out in the shape of a cone. Each scan will produce a report listing the items that it has located within the cone. The list will give you only the names and types of the items; not their distance, or coordinates, or any other data.
blocks.zh: 定向扫描从你的舰船出发，以锥形向外延伸。每次扫描都会生成一份报告，列出在扫描锥内发现的物体。列表只给出物体的名称和类型，不提供距离、坐标或其它任何数据。

blocks.en: As explained below, you can set the range and width of the cone. The widest search is a sphere. Its report will list any items found anywhere around your ship - but it will not give any directional information. The smallest search is a narrow cone. Its report will list far fewer items than the widest search, but you will know that they lie in the direction of the cone. (This is why it is called a directional scan.) If the scan is at all narrow, then you have to aim it in the direction that you want to scan.
blocks.zh: 如下文所述，你可以设置扫描锥的范围和宽度。最宽的扫描是一个球体，报告会列出你舰船周围任何方向上发现的物体，但不提供任何方向信息。最小的扫描是一个狭窄的锥体，报告列出的物体要比最宽的扫描少得多，但你能知道它们位于扫描锥所指的方向。（这就是它叫定向扫描的原因。）只要扫描角度不是全向的，就需要把它对准你想扫描的方向。

blocks.en: You can change the cone's viewing orientation in the d-scan window by left-click dragging to rotate the view and right-click dragging to move the view back and forth. Note that this does not aim the scanner, but only changes the display that you see in the window.
blocks.zh: 你可以在定向扫描窗口中改变扫描锥的观察视角：按住左键拖动旋转视角，按住右键拖动前后移动视角。注意这并不会改变扫描器的指向，只是改变窗口里的显示。

blocks.en: Aiming the d-scan cone
blocks.zh: 瞄准定向扫描锥

blocks.en: Aiming the d-scan
blocks.zh: 瞄准定向扫描

blocks.en: The easiest way to aim the scanner is to left-click on an object in the system map and hold until the radial menu pops up - then choose the d-scan icon from the menu. The scan cone will move to point at that object.
blocks.zh: 瞄准扫描器最简单的方法是在星系地图中对某个物体按住左键，直到弹出环形菜单，然后选择其中的定向扫描图标。扫描锥会转向指向该物体。

en: You can also right-click on an object in the map and choose "look at" from the drop down menu.
You can hold down the V key and click anywhere in space. With V down you can also click-drag to make a rectangle to which the scan will orient.
If you have brackets turned on in your Overview, you can right-click on any bracket and choose "look at" from the drop down menu.
zh: 也可以在地图中右键点击某个物体，在下拉菜单中选择“看向”（Look at）。
可以按住 V 键并点击太空中的任意位置。按住 V 时还可以按住鼠标拖出一个矩形，扫描会对准该区域。
如果你在总览中开启了标签框（brackets），可以右键点击任意标签框，在下拉菜单中选择“看向”（Look at）。

blocks.en: If you want the scanner to always point in the same direction as your ship, then:
blocks.zh: 如果你希望扫描器始终指向舰船朝向的方向：

en: In your ship's HUD, select "First Person" as your camera option
In the d-scan window, make sure that "Align with camera" is off.
zh: 在舰船 HUD 中，把镜头选项设置为“第一人称”（First Person）
在定向扫描窗口中，确保“与镜头对齐”（Align with camera）处于关闭状态。

blocks.en: Using the map
blocks.zh: 使用地图

blocks.en: The system map has a number of options that are useful while scanning.
blocks.zh: 星系地图有许多在扫描时很有用的选项。

en: The top left button allows you to add or remove objects from the map.
The second left button will "focus" the map, putting your ship in the center of the display.
The first right button will dock the map to either side of the screen, or make it full screen.
zh: 左上角第一个按钮可以添加或移除地图上显示的物体。
左侧第二个按钮可以“聚焦”地图，让你的舰船位于显示中心。
右侧第一个按钮可以把地图停靠在屏幕任意一侧，或切换为全屏。

blocks.en: The directional scanner has some useful features that are integrated into the system map.
blocks.zh: 定向扫描有一些整合在星系地图中的实用功能。

en: "Align with camera" allows you to rotate your perspective in the system map and simultaneously move your camera. On the map you will see a green circle that represents the scan cone, which now always points directly into the screen. Adjust the map, and whatever is in towards the screen from the ship and inside the circle will be scanned.
The show cone on/off button is sometimes useful when you need an unobstructed view of the system.
zh: “与镜头对齐”（Align with camera）可以让你在星系地图中旋转视角的同时移动镜头。地图上会出现一个代表扫描锥的绿色圆圈，它始终垂直指向屏幕内侧。调整地图后，从舰船朝屏幕内侧方向、位于圆圈内的一切都会被扫描到。
当你需要无遮挡地查看星系时，显示 / 隐藏扫描锥的开关有时会很有用。

blocks.en: D-scan parameter controls
blocks.zh: 定向扫描参数控制

blocks.en: The cone starts at your ship and reaches out for up to 14.3AU (appx. 2 x109 km - click the AU label button to change to KM). The range can be adjusted either by using the interval slider for 1, 5, 10, or 14.3 AUs, or by typing a specific scan range into the box.
blocks.zh: 扫描锥从你的舰船出发，最远延伸 14.3AU（约 2 x109 km，点击 AU 标签按钮可切换为 KM）。范围可以用滑块按 1、5、10 或 14.3 AU 档位调整，也可以在输入框中直接输入具体的扫描范围。

blocks.en: The cone can be narrow or wide. At its widest it is a 360° sphere; at its narrowest it is a 5° beam. The parameter that controls this is scan angle which is set via a slider in intervals of 5°, 15°, 30°, 60°, 90° 180° and 360°.
blocks.zh: 扫描锥可宽可窄。最宽时是 360° 的球体，最窄时是 5° 的光束。控制它的参数是扫描角度，通过滑块按 5°、15°、30°、60°、90°、180° 和 360° 档位设置。

blocks.en: Every time the scan button is pressed, the list in the directional scanner window updates to show all relevant objects in the scan cone. The scan also refreshes after you change the range, angle or filter parameters; and after jumping into another system. After a scan it takes two seconds for the scanner to reset.
blocks.zh: 每次按下扫描按钮，定向扫描窗口中的列表都会更新，显示扫描锥内所有相关物体。修改范围、角度或过滤参数后，以及跳跃到其它星系后，扫描结果也会刷新。每次扫描后，扫描器需要两秒冷却。

blocks.en: The list shows icon, name and type. It does not show distance or coordinates. Finding the distance to a target and/or its coordinates requires more advanced scanning equipment.
blocks.zh: 列表显示图标、名称和类型，不显示距离或坐标。要获取目标的距离和 / 或坐标，需要更高级的扫描设备。

blocks.en: D-scan results window
blocks.zh: 定向扫描结果窗口

blocks.en: A variety of filters can be set to narrow down the results of a scan. The filter selector in top right corner of the directional scan window opens a menu of possible filter configurations. The filters are listed, each with a number to the right. The number can be pressed on the keyboard to select a filter - or you can click on the number; or on the checkbox to the left of the filter.
blocks.zh: 可以设置多种过滤器来缩小扫描结果。定向扫描窗口右上角的过滤器选择器会打开一个可选过滤配置的菜单。每个过滤器右侧都有一个数字，可以在键盘上按对应数字选择该过滤器，也可以点击数字或过滤器左侧的复选框。

blocks.en: With the filter set to "all", anything that can be seen by the scanner will be displayed. With the filter set to "active overview" only objects permitted in the overview will be shown.
blocks.zh: 过滤器设为“全部”（all）时，扫描器能看到的一切都会显示出来。设为“当前总览”（active overview）时，只会显示总览设置中允许显示的物体。

blocks.en: The d-scan can use any of your overview presets to filter the results. Again, note that the scanner does not see any information about the objects other than name and type. This means that the filtering function will not take into account any of the state settings the overview may have. (The standard E-UNI overview setup is explained in Installing the EVE University Overview.)
blocks.zh: 定向扫描可以使用你的任意总览预设来过滤结果。再次提醒，扫描器除了名称和类型外看不到物体的任何信息。这意味着过滤功能不会考虑总览中的任何状态设置。（EVE University 的标准总览设置说明见安装 EVE University 总览。）

blocks.en: Some common d-scan uses - set these in an overview tab or tabs and then select the tab in the d-scan:
blocks.zh: 一些常见的定向扫描用法——在一个或多个总览标签页中设置好，然后在定向扫描中选择该标签页：

en: Ships. Visible ships, especially moving ones, are indicators that someone is active in the system.
Drones. Drones appearing in space with a ship usually indicate active combat.
Wrecks. If any are visible there has been someone fighting recently.
Combat scanner probes. Seeing these in space is an indicator of hostile intent.
Core scanner probes. Someone else is scanning sites. This is especially useful when running sites yourself as the hostile must scan your site before warping in.
Control towers and force fields. The force field of an active control tower is separate object in directional scan and can tell you if anyone is living in the system.
Precision scans can be used to see if a ship is near a force field, indicating unpiloted ship parked inside force field.
When gathering intel on hostile towers you can take a short range scan of the tower with all structures enabled and copy the results.
Upwell structures. While undockable structures aren't visible in overview they are visible in directional scan.
zh: 舰船。能看到舰船，尤其是移动中的舰船，说明有人在这个星系活动。
无人机。太空中出现无人机和舰船通常意味着正在交战。
残骸。如果能看到残骸，说明最近有人在战斗。
作战扫描探针。在太空中看到它们说明有人怀有敌意。
核心扫描探针。有其他人在扫站点。这在你自己做站点时特别有用，因为敌人必须先扫出你所在的站点才能跃迁进来。
控制塔和力场。运作中的控制塔的力场在定向扫描中是一个独立的物体，可以据此判断是否有人在这个星系常驻。
可以用精确扫描查看是否有舰船位于力场附近，这表明有无人驾驶的舰船停放在力场内。
收集敌方控制塔的情报时，可以开启所有建筑类别，对控制塔做一次短距离扫描并复制结果。
昇威建筑。不可停靠的建筑虽然不会显示在总览上，但能在定向扫描中看到。

blocks.en: Practical applications
blocks.zh: 实际应用

blocks.en: In solo PvP the d-scanner can be used to locate opponents at celestials (any stationary object in space) or cosmic signatures or cosmic anomalies.
blocks.zh: 在单人 PvP 中，定向扫描可以用来定位位于天体（太空中任何静止的物体）、宇宙信号或宇宙异常处的对手。

blocks.en: In fleets it is common for intel reports to be made by pasting the scanner results into an online parser. These can give a Fleet Commander intelligence on enemy fleet compositions to help decide whether an engagement is worth pursuing. Directional scanning is also widely used in mining and exploring to give early warning of hostile ships and/or combat probes. Good scanning can provide the vital seconds needed to escape an incoming attack.
blocks.zh: 在舰队中，常见的做法是把扫描结果粘贴到在线解析工具中来报告情报。这能让舰队指挥（FC）了解敌方舰队的构成，帮助判断是否值得开战。定向扫描也广泛用于采矿和探索，提前发现敌对舰船和 / 或作战探针。良好的扫描习惯能为你争取到逃离攻击的关键几秒。

blocks.en: The d-scan is a tool whose fundamental function is to detect hostile targets before a PvP engagement happens - whether they are trying to find you, or you are looking for them. Because it is standard equipment in every ship, and because it requires no specialized training, the d-scan is most pilots' first call for intelligence.
blocks.zh: 定向扫描的根本作用是在 PvP 交战发生之前发现敌对目标——无论是对方在找你，还是你在找对方。由于它是每艘舰船的标准装备，又不需要专门的技能训练，定向扫描是大多数飞行员获取情报的首选工具。

blocks.en: Offensive Scanning
blocks.zh: 进攻性扫描

blocks.en: An important use of the directional scanner is to find potential PvP targets. Keep in mind that the scanner only returns ship names and types; never the pilot's name. (This is the reason why you should rename your ships as soon as you buy them. Your name also appears on the system chat list, and an enemy can match the name with the ship.) Nor will the d-scan provide you with the specific distance to a ship, or its coordinates.
blocks.zh: 定向扫描的一个重要用途是寻找潜在的 PvP 目标。记住，扫描器只返回舰船名称和类型，永远不会显示飞行员的名字。（这就是为什么你买船后应该马上给它改名。你的名字也会出现在星系频道的列表里，敌人可以把名字和舰船对上号。）定向扫描也不会告诉你与某艘舰船的具体距离或其坐标。

blocks.en: The best way to show the use of the d-scan to locate ships is by example. Since every ship, even your capsule, has a d-scanner, you can do this exercise yourself ... and this is the best way to learn how it works. The next few images were created at High Sec Campus in Amygnon. This is a good place to practice scanning because there are almost always a bunch of ships in system.
blocks.zh: 要说明如何用定向扫描定位舰船，最好的办法是举个例子。由于每艘舰船，甚至你的太空舱，都有定向扫描，你可以自己动手做这个练习……这也是学会它的最佳方式。下面几张图是在 埃米格农 的 High Sec Campus 拍摄的。那里几乎总有一堆舰船，是练习扫描的好地方。

blocks.en: Even if you mostly plan to mine or explore, it is worthwhile at least reading this section. Hostile ships WILL be looking for you, and this is how they do it. If you try it yourself, you will have a better feel for the process and more easily defeat it when it happens to you.
blocks.zh: 即使你主要打算采矿或探索，也至少值得读一读这一节。敌对舰船一定会来找你，而这就是他们的做法。如果你亲自试一试，就能更好地体会这个过程，在别人这样对付你时也更容易化解。

blocks.en: (This is but one example. There are a variety of offensive d-scan techniques, covering different tactical situations.)
blocks.zh: （这只是一个例子。针对不同的战术场景，还有各种各样的进攻性定向扫描技巧。）

blocks.en: Celestials in directional scanner.
blocks.zh: 定向扫描中的天体。

blocks.en: So ... imagine that a hunter is looking for mining targets. The first thing that he or she does is to enter a system and look at the Overview to find a moon or planet with a number of nearby asteroid belts. In this case Amygnon VIII has three belts within d-scan range. So the hunter warps to the moon. The plan is to scan each of the asteroid belts looking for mining ships. Although the scanner will not give the range to a ship, it will give the range to the asteroid belt, enabling the hunter to warp in fairly close to the target.
blocks.zh: 那么……假设有一个猎手在寻找采矿目标。他或她要做的第一件事是进入星系，查看总览，找一颗附近有多个小行星带的卫星或行星。在这个例子中，埃米格农 VIII 的定向扫描范围内有三个小行星带。于是猎手跃迁到这颗卫星，打算逐一扫描每个小行星带，寻找采矿船。虽然扫描器不会给出与舰船的距离，但会给出与小行星带的距离，这样猎手就能跃迁到离目标相当近的位置。

blocks.en: View of the planet, its moons and asteroid belts on the map.
blocks.zh: 地图上显示的行星及其卫星和小行星带。

blocks.en: Notice that the icon for asteroid belt on the Overview is a pyramid of three dots. This same icon will be used in the d-scan map to show belts.
blocks.zh: 注意，总览上小行星带的图标是三个点组成的金字塔形。定向扫描地图中也用同样的图标表示小行星带。

blocks.en: Next the hunter sets the scanner range to match that of the farthest asteroid belt (in this case 5 AU), and sets the angle to something that will blanket the belt (in this case 30°). Using the first menu at the top left of the Map, the hunter unchecks all the boxes except for Asteroid Belts. The next step is to zoom the Map in as close as possible.
blocks.zh: 接下来，猎手把扫描范围设为与最远的小行星带相同（这里是 5 AU），并把角度设为足以覆盖整个矿带的大小（这里是 30°）。猎手用地图左上角的第一个菜单，取消勾选除小行星带以外的所有选项，然后把地图尽可能放大。

blocks.en: Use the radial menu inside the Map to aim the scanner.
blocks.zh: 使用地图中的环形菜单瞄准扫描器。

blocks.en: As you can see on the image to the right, only asteroid belts are now marked on the map (the icon for a belt is a cluster of 3 dots). The hunter selects one of these, and using the radial menu (left click on the belt icon and choose the scanner icon when it pops up) points the scanner; then the hunter initiates a scan.
blocks.zh: 如右图所示，地图上现在只标出了小行星带（小行星带的图标是 3 个点组成的一簇）。猎手选中其中一个，用环形菜单（在矿带图标上按住左键，弹出后选择扫描器图标）把扫描器对准它，然后开始扫描。

blocks.en: That first scan is empty (and not shown here). So the hunter clicks on the next belt icon, aims the scanner and takes another snapshot. This second scan shows three ships: a Skiff, a Miasmos and a Moa. Keep in mind that the scanner is finding ALL visible ships in its range, and since there some stations nearby, ships docking and undocking will show up in the scan. On the other hand, the Skiff is a mining vessel, and likely to be in the asteroid belt.
blocks.zh: 第一次扫描什么也没扫到（此处未显示）。于是猎手点击下一个矿带图标，对准扫描器，再扫一次。这次扫描显示了三艘舰船：一艘轻舟级、一艘米亚莫斯级和一艘巨鸟级。要记住，扫描器会找到其范围内所有可见的舰船，附近还有几个空间站，所以停靠和离站的舰船也会出现在扫描结果里。不过，轻舟级是采矿船，很可能就在小行星带里。

blocks.en: So the hunter warps to that belt. At this point, the Skiff shows up in the Overview at a distance of 123K and can be targeted.
blocks.zh: 于是猎手跃迁到那个矿带。此时，轻舟级出现在总览上，距离 123K，可以锁定。

blocks.en: Let's assume that the Skiff pilot, a good Unista, has been keeping close watch and has noticed the hunter's ship as it was lurking by the moon making these scans. The Skiff would not know where the hunter was, but it would know what the hunter was. So even as the hunter is warping in, the Skiff has finished pulling in its drones and aligning for warp. And away it goes!
blocks.zh: 假设这位轻舟级飞行员是个合格的 Unista，一直在密切留意，注意到猎手的舰船在卫星附近徘徊进行扫描。轻舟级不会知道猎手在哪里，但会知道猎手是什么船。所以就在猎手跃迁过来的同时，轻舟级已经收回了无人机并对准了跃迁方向。然后它就溜了！

blocks.en: No problem. The hunter now goes back to the map, selects the third asteroid belt and repeats the scanning process. There it finds a Procurer, surrounded by cargo containers and dead belt pirates. This belt is only 0.3 AU away, and the hunter warps in a mere 21 K from the Procurer.
blocks.zh: 没关系。猎手回到地图，选中第三个小行星带，重复扫描过程。在那里发现了一艘猎获级，周围是货柜和被击毁的矿带海盗。这个矿带只有 0.3 AU 远，猎手跃迁到距离猎获级仅 21 K 的位置。

blocks.en: A short, one-sided fight occurs, and then the hunter grabs the loot and departs from the system.
blocks.zh: 一场短暂的一边倒的战斗之后，猎手捡走战利品，离开了星系。

blocks.en: The first time you do this, it seems clunky. Sitting and scanning takes awhile. But after a few tries, it becomes second nature. You set up the d-scan filter before you even enter the system, and you know from experience what ranges and angles you need to use. In cases where you are looking for ships that can be found in fixed locations ... in asteroid belts, for example, or undocking from a particular station ... this method will find more targets faster than probe scanning will. (You still need probes in situations where your target might be off the grid, or where the target is not located near an object that you can warp to. Remember that the d-scanner never gives you coordinates.)
blocks.zh: 第一次这样做时会觉得很笨拙，坐着扫描要花不少时间。但试过几次之后，就会变成本能反应。你在进入星系之前就设好定向扫描过滤器，并凭经验知道需要用什么范围和角度。在寻找位于固定地点的舰船时……比如在小行星带里，或者从某个空间站离站……这种方法会比探针扫描更快地找到更多目标。（如果目标可能不在网格上，或者目标不在你可以跃迁到的物体附近，你仍然需要探针。记住，定向扫描永远不会给你坐标。）

blocks.en: Defensive Scanning
blocks.zh: 防御性扫描

blocks.en: "Defense" refers to the need to scan for possibly hostile ships while mining or exploring. A better term for this might be "situational awareness" - the need to keep an eye on your environment whenever you are in dangerous territory.
blocks.zh: “防御”指的是在采矿或探索时需要扫描可能存在的敌对舰船。更贴切的说法也许是“态势感知”——只要身处危险区域，就需要时刻留意周围环境。

blocks.en: Various articles in the UNIWiki discuss the tactics of survival while exploring or mining. For example:
blocks.zh: UNIWiki 中有很多文章讨论探索或采矿时的生存战术。例如：

en: From Surviving While Exploring: "While running the site, and particularly while in the minigame, keep your overview and Local visible, and keep running D-Scan."
zh: 摘自探索时的生存：“做站点时，尤其是在小游戏中，要让总览和本地频道保持可见，并持续使用定向扫描。”

blocks.en: You will want to read about the specifics of your own profession, but here are a few general comments about using the d-scan for situational awareness.
blocks.zh: 你应该去阅读与自己职业相关的具体内容，不过这里先给出一些关于用定向扫描保持态势感知的通用建议。

blocks.en: Spam Scan
blocks.zh: 频繁扫描

blocks.en: Naturally, you will scan the system before you set up your operation. Once you are started, however, you should refresh the scan periodically. You can rescan by clicking on the large SCAN button, or you can set up the "Refresh Directional Scan" hotkey.
blocks.zh: 当然，在开始作业之前你会先扫描一下星系。但开始之后，也应该定期刷新扫描。可以点击大大的“扫描”（SCAN）按钮重新扫描，也可以设置“刷新定向扫描”（Refresh Directional Scan）快捷键。

blocks.en: Your goal is to spot ships as soon as they come into range, decide whether they are potentially hostile, and then decide how to respond. There are no specific rules for doing this; you will need to develop a plan that is comfortable for you, but here are a few basic techniques.
blocks.zh: 你的目标是在舰船进入范围时尽快发现它们，判断它们是否可能有敌意，然后决定如何应对。这没有固定的规则，你需要制定一套适合自己的方案，不过这里有几个基本技巧。

en: Know your ships. Industrials, and even combat ships that are significantly less powerful than yours, can be ignored. You might want to set your Info Window to "Traits". That way if a ship you've never seen before shows up in the scanner, you can do a quick Show Info and immediately see its size and combat characteristics.

Spam to danger level. If you are in a wormhole, you probably want to be spamming the scan every few seconds or so ... every 8-10 seconds is often recommended. You do this because ANY ship that shows up is likely to be dangerous, even industrials and exploration frigates, and many will have expert pilots who can locate you very quickly. In a wormhole you may only have seconds to respond to an intrusion, so spam the scan and get every advantage that you can. In a level 0.9 system you may only want to scan every minute or so. Some people don't scan at all in high sec ... but the danger is still there ... high sec gankers are often slow and inexperienced, so you can get away with LESS scanning, but it is tempting fate to do NONE.

Align to exit. When you set up your operation, take the time to point your ship in the direction you want to warp should you need to run. This may not turn out to be helpful in terms of speed, but it gives you one less thing to think about if a hostile suddenly appears.

Move around. Particularly if you are mining, when you finish an asteroid, move to another belt and repeat. There are a variety of combat ships that your scanner simply cannot see, and there is no worse feeling that the sudden panic that you feel when a ship decloaks and tackles you. The longer you sit in one place, the more vulnerable you become.
zh: 了解各种舰船。工业舰，以及明显比你弱的战斗舰船，都可以不用理会。你可以把信息窗口设为显示“特性”（Traits）。这样当扫描器里出现一艘你从没见过的舰船时，可以快速查看信息，立即了解它的体型和作战特点。

按危险程度决定扫描频率。如果你在虫洞里，大概需要每隔几秒就扫一次……通常建议每 8-10 秒一次。这是因为出现的任何舰船都可能是危险的，即使是工业舰和探索护卫舰也一样，而且很多都是能很快找到你的老手。在虫洞里，你可能只有几秒钟来应对入侵者，所以要频繁扫描，争取一切可能的优势。在 0.9 安全等级的星系，大概每分钟左右扫一次就够了。有些人在高安根本不扫……但危险依然存在……高安的自杀式攻击者往往动作慢、经验少，所以你可以扫得少一些，但完全不扫就是在玩火了。
对准撤离方向。开始作业时，花点时间把舰船朝向你需要逃跑时要跃迁的方向。这在速度上未必有多大帮助，但当敌人突然出现时，你就少了一件需要考虑的事。
经常移动。尤其是在采矿时，挖完一块小行星后，就换到另一个矿带重复作业。有好几种战斗舰船是你的扫描器根本看不到的，而一艘船突然解除隐形并拦截你时的那种恐慌，是最糟糕的感受。你在一个地方待得越久，就越容易受到攻击。

blocks.en: How you respond to a potentially hostile contact depends on your ship's capabilities, your location, and your level of paranoia. If you are mining in an asteroid belt within a few AU of a station, for example, you may see a constant flow of combat ships passing through your scanner. It's the ship that persists on your scan for more than a few seconds that ought to concern you. A reasonable response might be to move to a more distant asteroid belt and watch to see if the same ship reappears. On the other hand, there are very few reasons to be passing through a wormhole, so any contact should be treated with deep suspicion.
blocks.zh: 如何应对可能有敌意的目标，取决于你的舰船性能、所在位置以及你的警惕程度。比如，如果你在离空间站几 AU 以内的小行星带采矿，扫描器里可能会不断有战斗舰船经过。真正值得你担心的，是在扫描结果中停留超过几秒的舰船。一个合理的应对是换到更远的小行星带，观察同一艘舰船是否再次出现。另一方面，穿过虫洞的理由少之又少，所以任何目标都应该高度怀疑。

blocks.en: Probes
blocks.zh: 探针

blocks.en: While a good pilot can find you quickly using the d-scan, some hostiles rely primarily on combat probes. In any case, you should always use a d-scan filter that include probes.
blocks.zh: 虽然老练的飞行员用定向扫描就能很快找到你，但也有一些敌人主要依靠作战探针。无论如何，你都应该始终使用包含探针的定向扫描过滤器。

en: While "core" scanner probes cannot locate ships, their presence may indicate a cloaked ship. So you should include them in your filter.

It will generally take at least 4 "combat" probes at a distance of 2 AU or less to pinpoint your position. A good rule of thumb is to run the scan at 360° at a range of 5-10 AU. Probes outside that range are not close to finding you, and ships outside that range will probably take some time to get a fix on your position.
zh: 虽然“核心”扫描探针无法定位舰船，但它们的存在可能意味着附近有隐形舰船。所以过滤器里也应该包含它们。
通常至少需要 4 个距离你 2 AU 以内的“作战”探针才能精确定位你的位置。一个好的经验法则是用 360°、5-10 AU 的范围扫描。这个范围之外的探针离找到你还很远，这个范围之外的舰船也可能需要一段时间才能锁定你的位置。

blocks.en: Probes themselves cannot hurt you; it is the ships that are controlling them that you have to worry about. Core scanner probes at a long distance may just be someone scanning for resources and probably should just be watched. Combat probes close to you should suggest a very high level of danger.
blocks.zh: 探针本身伤害不了你，你要担心的是控制它们的舰船。远处的核心扫描探针可能只是有人在扫资源，留意观察即可。而离你很近的作战探针则意味着非常高的危险。

blocks.en: Cloaky Ships
blocks.zh: 隐形舰船

blocks.en: Remember that cloaked ships and certain "scan immune" ships will not appear on the directional scanner, so covert ops frigates, stealth bombers, recons, and Tech 3 strategic cruisers (in some configurations) will be able to warp to you without being detected.
blocks.zh: 记住，隐形中的舰船以及某些“免疫扫描”的舰船不会出现在定向扫描中，因此隐形特勤舰、隐形轰炸舰、侦察舰以及（某些配置下的）T3 战略巡洋舰都能在不被发现的情况下跃迁到你身边。

en: If a cloaked ship is using probes, the probes will show up on your scan even though the ship will not. So if you see probes, but no ship, assume that a cloaked ship is out there somewhere.

Depending on a pilot's skill, cloaked ships may become visible for a few seconds as they move away just after coming through a gate. If you see a brief contact that isn't there when you rescan, treat it seriously. (This is also a good argument for frequent rescanning, even in higher sec systems.)

Buying and equipping a cloak ship is usually an expensive proposition, and making piracy pay depends not on the ships killed, but the cargo. Many pilots will wait patiently for you to fill your cargo hold before they attack. On your part, you need to know the risk/reward situation. Maybe your mining hold is only half full, but if this is a dangerous system, it still may be time to warp to a base and empty it out. Maybe you haven't checked every artifact that you can see ... but what is the value of the stuff in your cargo hold? Know the risk; and head out when you have enough.

Pilots of cloaky ships tend to be careful and methodical. So, especially when mining, if you move frequently, causing them to need to restart their search, they may either decide that it's too much work, or they may move too fast and make a mistake. Try not to stay in the same place for very long.
zh: 如果隐形舰船在使用探针，即使舰船本身不会出现，探针也会出现在你的扫描结果中。所以如果你看到了探针却没看到舰船，就应该假定附近某处有一艘隐形舰船。
取决于飞行员的技术，隐形舰船刚穿过星门、离开时可能会有几秒钟可见。如果你看到一个短暂出现、再扫时又消失的目标，要认真对待。（这也是即使在高安星系也要经常重新扫描的一个好理由。）
购买并装配一艘隐形舰船通常代价不菲，而海盗能否赚钱不在于击毁了多少舰船，而在于货物。很多飞行员会耐心等你装满货舱后再动手。对你来说，需要清楚风险与收益。也许你的矿石舱才装了一半，但如果这是个危险的星系，也许就该跃迁回基地清空它了。也许你还没检查完看得到的每一个遗物……但你货舱里的东西值多少？要了解风险，赚够了就撤。
隐形舰船的飞行员往往谨慎而有条理。所以，尤其是在采矿时，如果你经常移动，迫使他们重新开始搜索，他们要么会觉得太麻烦而放弃，要么会因为操之过急而犯错。尽量不要在同一个地方待太久。

blocks.en: Scouting
blocks.zh: 侦察

blocks.en: If you are scouting for a fleet, you can pass your scan results to the FC through Mumble or chat. More complete results can also be sent using online parsers like Dashboard or Capsuleers.app. A parser will organize and check the value of your scan results and set them up to be passed on to your FC.
blocks.zh: 如果你在为舰队侦察，可以通过 Mumble 或聊天频道把扫描结果告诉 FC。也可以使用 Dashboard 或 Capsuleers.app 等在线解析工具发送更完整的结果。解析工具会整理你的扫描结果、核算价值，并整理成方便发给 FC 的形式。

blocks.en: Note: To move the entire results of a scan. Click one of the result items. Press Ctrl+A to select all items. Press Ctrl+C to copy all the results. Go to where you want to put the results and press Ctrl+V to paste them.
blocks.zh: 注意：要转移全部扫描结果，点击其中一条结果，按 Ctrl+A 全选，按 Ctrl+C 复制全部结果，然后到要放结果的地方按 Ctrl+V 粘贴。

blocks.en: The d-scanner can also be used to check gates for gate camps or warp disruption bubbles (in null-sec) without warping to the gate's grid. You will need to have an off-grid bookmark near the gate from which you can scan it.
blocks.zh: 定向扫描还可以用来检查星门是否有堵门或（00 区的）跃迁扰断泡，而无需跃迁到星门所在的网格。你需要在星门附近有一个不在同一网格的书签，从那里进行扫描。

blocks.en: In low or null-sec, directional scanning can be used to check for player owned starbases (POS) and other interesting structures near moons, bases or belts.
blocks.zh: 在低安或 00 区，定向扫描可以用来检查卫星、基地或矿带附近是否有玩家拥有的母星（POS）以及其它值得关注的建筑。

blocks.en: Links
blocks.zh: 链接

en: Dev blog: Scanning and Probing Changes in Parallax explains the 2015 changes to the d-scan interface. (It also covers changes to probe scanning.)
Note that as of November 2015, all YouTube videos about D-Scanning are showing the old interface, and so are out of date. You can look for new videos by searching on "EVE directional scan".
zh: 开发者博客：Scanning and Probing Changes in Parallax，介绍了 2015 年定向扫描界面的改动。（也涉及探针扫描的改动。）
注意，截至 2015 年 11 月，所有关于定向扫描的 YouTube 视频展示的都是旧界面，已经过时。可以搜索“EVE directional scan”寻找新视频。
